Why Your Child's Coding Certificate Won't Matter in 2030 (And What Will)

Coding bootcamps for kids are everywhere. Here is why creative intelligence and reasoning matter more than certificates.

Every mall has a coding camp. Certificates are printed. Parents feel they have future-proofed their child. But AI coding assistants have already changed what 'knowing syntax' is worth.

What will matter in 2030: can your child identify a real problem, design a solution, build a prototype, and persuade someone it works? That is Builders and Innovators territory, not drag-and-drop certificate mills.
